title: Acquirer: Statewest Credit Society Ltd; Target: Breweries Union Credit Society Ltd

body_sections.Summary: By letter dated 21 June 2004, APRA informed the ACCC of the proposed transfer of the entire business of Breweries Union Credit Society Ltd to Statewest Credit Society Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: For practical purposes, the relevant product market in this instance was treated as a broadly defined market for financial services.
